description: 11e End of Turn: 'if you met the conditions on one or more Secondary Missions, you CAN gain the VP ... If you do ... discard that Secondary Mission'. Scoring is optional. Player 1 meets Display of Might (2 VP end of own turn / 5 VP end of opponent's). Entering Scoring must only OFFER it (no VP, card kept); the right panel shows Score 2 VP / Hold. The player clicks Hold, the End Turn dialog reflects it, End Turn scores nothing and keeps the card; at the end of the opponent's turn the held card pays 5 VP and is discarded.

steps.script:
# Offer only — nothing scored, card still in hand
var p = GameState.get_active_player()
var st = SecondaryMissionManager._player_state[str(p)]
return "vp=%d ids=%s" % [int(st["secondary_vp"]), str(st["active"].map(func(m): return m["id"]))]

steps.equals: Score or Hold Secondary Missions|Score 2 VP|false|true

steps.script:
# Turn ended with the card HELD: no VP, card still active, offer cleared
var st = SecondaryMissionManager._player_state[str(Engine.get_meta("soh_player"))]
return "vp=%d ids=%s pending=%d" % [int(st["secondary_vp"]), str(st["active"].map(func(m): return m["id"])), SecondaryMissionManager.get_pending_secondary_scores(int(Engine.get_meta("soh_player"))).size()]

# End of the OPPONENT's turn: the held Display of Might pays the big 5 VP
var st = SecondaryMissionManager._player_state[str(Engine.get_meta("soh_player"))]
return "vp=%d ids=%s" % [int(st["secondary_vp"]), str(st["active"].map(func(m): return m["id"]))]
